newsitem.title: UK: IFC analyst bullish on E.Europe stock mkt growth.
newsitem.headline: IFC analyst bullish on E.Europe stock mkt growth.

text.p: Central and Eastern European stock markets are rapidly growing as governments implement market-orientated policies, an International Finance Corp analyst told a news conference on Friday.

The opening of new sectors to foreign investment, the restructuring of corporate sectors, privatisation of state-owned companies and the creation of new investment markets were also boosting the growth in stock markets, Constantinos Grigoriadis, IFC's head market analyst Central and Eastern Europe said.
In the next three years, efforts to improve the foreign investment climate would continue, privatisations would continue and equities would increasingly be floated in local markets, Grigoriadis said.
Added to this, direct investment would continue to grow on an intra-regional level and investors would shift capital to emerging markets as local governments embraced market reforms.
